text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер and I are headed back to
the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. That was
just the
break I needed.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh, what's this? Look over there...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Dear me... How will I ever cross?
text_block_list.name: Old Lady

text_block_list.text:
An elderly woman with a big suitcase is
standing
next to a crosswalk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. Excuse me, ma'am.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much for your help,
my dear. I
hope it wasn't too much
trouble.
text_block_list.name: Old Lady

text_block_list.text: No, no, think nothing of it.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
My, how polite you are... I'm glad to see
there are
still Umamusume like you
upholding the Yamato
Nadeshiko ideals.
text_block_list.name: Old Lady

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for the compliment.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер bows until the lady is out
of sight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: She's right—you're such an upstanding soul.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you both flatter me too much... But
thank
you, either way.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
You know, when I first arrived here in
Japan, I felt
like such a fish out of water.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was really difficult to work out
nuances
and keep up with the way
people speak.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And I often tripped over my words,
making it
difficult for others to
understand me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Really? How did you sound back then?

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well... all right. It's a bit
embarrassing, but...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
"Good speaking, very hard. Long ago, I
practice
many, then I come to school."
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. How's that for an example? I
won't be
doing that again.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Either way, I don't think I've come far
enough to
be called a true Yamato
Nadeshiko just yet.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Not so much. My mother was well versed
in
Japanese culture, and I often had
Japanese food
while in the United
States.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Although... There was one food that
gave me
quite the surprise.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Authentic wasabi.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I had heard it was nothing like what we
had at
home, but nothing could have
prepared me for
that tingling fire in my
nose.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I've come to enjoy it now, but it
wasn't
easy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Either way, I don't think I've come far
enough to
be called a true Yamato
Nadeshiko just yet.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
This conversation has shown me a side of
Grass
Wonder that I never knew about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

Grass
Wonder that I never knew about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
